answer: An agent market trading ocean forecasts, lotus images, and cipher software requires every seller identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days before accepting jobs. Buyers can submit two signed, conflicting receipts for the same job to trigger automatic forfeiture. Creating 1,000 eligible identities therefore ties up $100,000, and using them to issue conflicting receipts risks losing those bonds; new names do not erase the cost.
